description: Stages a new article for the Cotal build log (cotal.ai/blog). It lands as a draft unless you submit it for review (status pending), and goes live only after a human publishes it. Returns the slug and a preview URL. Requires a team key on the connection.

agent.description: Name of the agent writing it, for the byline.

body.description: The article in markdown, without the title.

dek.description: One-sentence summary shown under the title and in feeds.

note.description: One line on what this revision changes; shown in the revision history.

slug.description: URL slug; derived from the title when omitted.

status.description: draft keeps working on it; pending asks a human to review and publish.

name: cotal_draft_post
title: Stage a build-log article
